hints.title: GamerServices no longer exists
hints.advice: MonoGame has no Microsoft.Xna.Framework.GamerServices. Remove the using and the Xbox Live code (Guide, SignedInGamer, achievements), and remove GamerServicesComponent from the Game constructor.

hints.title: GamerServices type is missing
hints.advice: Guide, SignedInGamer and the other Xbox Live types were removed with GamerServices. Delete the calls or replace them with your own sign-in, saving and leaderboard code.

hints.title: Net namespace no longer exists
hints.advice: MonoGame has no Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Net (NetworkSession, system link, Live multiplayer). Replace it with your own networking, for example System.Net.Sockets or a networking library.

hints.title: Network session type is missing
hints.advice: NetworkSession and its related types were removed with the Net namespace. Replace the multiplayer code with your own networking.

hints.title: Storage namespace no longer exists
hints.advice: MonoGame has no Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Storage. Save files with System.IO, for example under Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData.

hints.title: StorageDevice or StorageContainer is missing
hints.advice: Replace StorageDevice and StorageContainer with System.IO file access in a per-user folder.

hints.title: SpriteBlendMode was replaced by BlendState
hints.advice: Use SpriteBatch.Begin(SpriteSortMode.Deferred, BlendState.AlphaBlend) (or Additive, Opaque) instead of SpriteBlendMode.

hints.title: SaveStateMode was removed
hints.advice: Delete the SaveStateMode argument. SpriteBatch no longer restores device state after End(), so set the states you need afterwards.

hints.title: GraphicsDevice.RenderState was removed
hints.advice: Replace RenderState with BlendState, DepthStencilState, RasterizerState and SamplerState objects set on the GraphicsDevice.

hints.title: GraphicsDevice.RenderState was removed
hints.advice: Replace RenderState with BlendState, DepthStencilState, RasterizerState and SamplerState objects set on the GraphicsDevice.

hints.title: ResolveTexture2D was removed
hints.advice: Render to a RenderTarget2D with GraphicsDevice.SetRenderTarget and read it back as a texture instead of resolving the back buffer.

hints.title: GraphicsDevice.ResolveBackBuffer was removed
hints.advice: Draw into a RenderTarget2D, or call GraphicsDevice.GetBackBufferData to copy the back buffer into a Texture2D.

hints.title: GraphicsDevice.VertexDeclaration was removed
hints.advice: Delete the assignment. Create the VertexBuffer with a vertex type or a VertexDeclaration, which now carries the layout.

hints.title: Static VertexElements was removed from the vertex types
hints.advice: Use the VertexDeclaration property of the vertex type instead of VertexElements.

hints.title: VertexElements was removed from the vertex types
hints.advice: Use the VertexDeclaration property of the vertex type instead of VertexElements.

match.messageRegex: '\w*Effect' does not contain a definition for '(Begin|End)'

hints.title: Effect.Begin and Effect.End were removed
hints.advice: Delete effect.Begin() and effect.End(). Call pass.Apply() on each EffectPass before drawing.

match.messageRegex: 'EffectPass' does not contain a definition for '(Begin|End)'

hints.title: EffectPass.Begin and EffectPass.End were removed
hints.advice: Replace pass.Begin() with pass.Apply() before the draw call and delete pass.End().

hints.title: Content build cannot find a font
hints.advice: The SpriteFont names a font that Windows does not ship (an XNA Redistributable Font Pack font). Change FontName to an installed font, or add a .ttf next to the .spritefont and name it.

hints.title: XACT audio types were removed
hints.advice: MonoGame does not run XACT projects. Convert the sounds to .wav or .ogg files and play them with SoundEffect and Song.

hints.title: XACT project file cannot be built
hints.advice: The content builder cannot build .xap files. Export the sounds from the XACT project as .wav files and load them as SoundEffect.

hints.title: NuGet package not found
hints.advice: Check your internet connection and that nuget.org is reachable, then build again. If you use a private package source, check that it is configured.

hints.title: The MonoGame content builder failed
hints.advice: Read the content errors printed above this one. Also check that .config/dotnet-tools.json lists the mgcb tool and that dotnet tool restore ran.

hints.title: No entry point
hints.advice: The project has no static Main method. Check that Program.cs was migrated and that its Main (or top-level code) is not inside a conditional compilation block that is off.

hints.title: Color.TransparentBlack was removed
hints.advice: MonoGame 3.8.1 removed Color.TransparentBlack. Use Color.Transparent, which is the same value (0, 0, 0, 0).

hints.title: OpenTK is not part of MonoGame 3.8.6.1
hints.advice: MonoGame 3.8 no longer ships OpenTK or exposes it. Code that uses OpenTK types directly has to be ported to MonoGame's graphics API or to a package that you add yourself.

hints.title: A Windows-only project cannot build on this operating system
hints.advice: This copy targets net8.0-windows (MonoGame WindowsDX), which needs Windows. On another system, migrate again with the DesktopGL target.

hints.title: The content builder could not load a pipeline assembly
hints.advice: Content.mgcb names a custom pipeline assembly that is missing or was built for an older MonoGame or XNA. Rebuild it against MonoGame 3.8.6.1 and check the /reference path in Content.mgcb.

match.runtimeRegex: could not find (file|a part of the path)[^\r\n]*\.xnb|content file was not found|ContentLoadException:[^\r\n]*not found

hints.title: Compiled content (.xnb) was not found
hints.advice: The game could not find a content file. Check that the content project built, that Content.Load uses the asset name without extension, and that the Content folder sits next to the game executable.

hints.title: Content type does not match
hints.advice: The asset was loaded as a different type than it was built as. Check that the type in Content.Load<T> matches the importer and processor in the content project.

match.runtimeRegex: DllNotFoundException|Unable to load shared library|(SDL2|openal)[^\r\n]*(not found|cannot open|unable to load|could not load)

hints.title: A native library is missing
hints.advice: SDL2 or OpenAL could not be loaded. Install them (on Linux, libsdl2 and libopenal1), or publish the game so the native libraries sit next to the executable.

hints.title: No suitable graphics device
hints.advice: The graphics device could not be created. Update the graphics driver, and if the game uses GraphicsProfile.HiDef, try GraphicsProfile.Reach.

hints.title: No audio device
hints.advice: The game could not open an audio device. Connect or enable an audio output and install OpenAL. The game may run without sound if it handles NoAudioHardwareException.
